label: Shopping
tooltip: Auto-buy from the Expedition Antiquarian when silver or gold currency hits a threshold.

enable_auto_shop.label: Enable auto-shop
enable_auto_shop.tooltip:
On: when silver or gold reaches its threshold, pause other automation, go to camp, and buy from your shopping list.
Off: never auto-shop.

silver_threshold.label: Silver threshold
silver_threshold.tooltip: Start shopping when silver pieces (South Horn) or silver obols (North Horn) reach this. 0 = never start from silver.

gold_threshold.label: Gold threshold
gold_threshold.tooltip: Start shopping when gold pieces (South Horn) or gold obols (North Horn) reach this. 0 = never start from gold.

reserve_silver.label: Keep at least (silver)
reserve_silver.tooltip: Do not spend silver below this amount.

reserve_gold.label: Keep at least (gold)
reserve_gold.tooltip: Do not spend gold below this amount.

shopping_order.label: Shopping list
shopping_order.tooltip: Keep stock, Buy a set count, or Keep Buying as a currency sink. Empty = do not auto-shop.
shopping_order.when_ready_hint: Shop when silver or gold reaches its threshold. Keep at least leaves a reserve unspent.
shopping_order.zone_any: Currency type follows the Occult Crescent zone you are in.
shopping_order.empty: No items — add from the catalog.
shopping_order.modes_help:
Keep: buy until you have this many in inventory (restocks each trip).
Buy: buy this many times, then stop (counts down).
Sink: after Keep/Buy are done, keep spending on this one item (only one Sink allowed).
